explication: NeMo Megatron Bridge is a model-development library for converting model checkpoints and configuring large-scale LLM, multimodal, and diffusion workloads. The principal user workflow is to bring a Hugging Face model into Megatron-compatible form, configure and train or fine-tune it, then save or convert checkpoints for inference. The graph also preserves inference, data preparation, PEFT, and diffusion as distinct capabilities. Most runtime relationships are not exposed in the excerpts, so edges are limited to documented capabilities or indexed source references; unsampled implementation links are omitted.
